entries.wording: Parcel has been registered in the system
entries.note: The API sends the code only; the wording is the partner API manual's definition. Its place is the sender, which the adapter drops.

entries.wording: The parcel has been placed in the locker
entries.note: The sender's drop-off at a locker or BOX NOW store; the wording is the Cypriot tracker's English one.

entries.wording: The parcel has been placed in the locker
entries.note: The Bulgarian tracker shows it like accepted-to-locker.

entries.wording: Parcel is being transferred to a specific location
entries.note: Seen as a parcel's state; the trackers then show the newest scan's type.

entries.wording: Parcel is in one of our warehouses
entries.note: Its place names the hub or depot.

entries.wording: Parcel is waiting in a specific APM to be taken over by BOX NOW courier
entries.note: The manual adds that the courier takes it back to the sender or on to another locker.

entries.wording: Parcel has reached its final destination, waiting for pickup
entries.note: Its place names the recipient's locker.

entries.wording: Parcel has reached its final destination, waiting for pickup
entries.note: The state of a parcel whose newest scan is final-destination.
The recipient took the parcel out of the locker; the scan has no place.

entries.wording: Parcel has been returned to the sender

entries.note: The trackers show it in red with the other ended states.
Listed among the manual's states; the wording is the trackers' English one.

entries.wording: Parcel search - We will update you shortly
entries.note: A webhook event in the manual; the wording is the Cypriot tracker's English one.
Listed among the manual's states; the wording is the Bulgarian and Croatian trackers' English one.

entries.wording: Parcel order had been cancelled by the sender
Parcel order had been cancelled by the sender
Return of parcel, cancelled by sender
The parcel has been placed in the locker
entries.note: Left without a stage: the trackers show it like a sender drop-off, and no reply showed whether it ends the delivery or starts a return to the sender.
